selected: C: existing Match Physical Play Owner owns one common absolute clock anchored at contact, with action offsets

alternatives.benefit: natural same-ball origin for runner and cover movement
alternatives.limitation: needs versioned physical owner to persist origin and offsets across legs/replay

alternatives.benefit: current S8 first launch0 fits simple direct receive
alternatives.limitation: prelaunch movement becomes signed; relay resetting would lose chronology; original launch offset absent in v1

alternatives.benefit: single owner/common origin for cover,runner,delivery,relay and Save; local launch is derived projection only
alternatives.cost: new source fields/model clock policies and explicit contract versions required

timeOwnership.contact: physical owner creates shared origin at raw contact; NEW software clock model, not measured seconds
timeOwnership.SSLaunch: NEW acquisition/transfer duration clock from original stage facts; requires reviewed policy version/calibration
timeOwnership.ballArrival: launch+NEW flightDuration policy using canonical distance/quality; release belongs in launch exactly once, no double count
timeOwnership.runnerArrival: original runner state inputs feed separately reviewed NEW contact-relative runner clock; old v1 quantity remains diagnostic A/B, not automatically anchored
timeOwnership.positioning: frozen formation+NEW start/movement policy; signed start allowed if source identifies precontact activity
timeOwnership.receiveAttempt: only receivable arrival and receiver ready at arrival; no late hands attempt
timeOwnership.Secure: attempt+independent hands clean/bobble delay, possession required
timeOwnership.relay: same physical origin and absolute offsets; current leg launch follows validated prior stage; actual force/third-out authority remains original owners

precision.input: strict decimal CRT text, max6 fractional digits; no exponent, no ordinal windows
precision.arithmetic: BigInt exact source micro-CRT difference (time-origin), then half-away-from-zero once to 1000 ticks/CRT
precision.ties: quantization may collapse near margins; exact tick tie creates no candidate/out
precision.causalOrder: check exact decimal micro-values BEFORE rounding; negative duration rejected even if would collapse to tick tie
precision.overflow: relative ticks bounded +/-1e9; reject, no clamp
precision.unknown: retain unknown reason; missing origin blocks interpretation
precision.clockUnits: coarse relative model CRT, never seconds/meters

prelaunch.example: contact0, positionStart.25, launch2 -> launch-local positioning=-1.75CRT; no clamp

compatibility.v1BallNumber: not flight duration; includes release contribution in original formula
compatibility.v1RunnerNumber: unanchored scalar; cannot assign contact0 silently
compatibility.policy: old model/timing path preserved; unknown versions reject; no adding v2 delay to v1 resolved timing
